title: Use a colour map
summary: A map pairs names with values, like labels on paint pots.
introduction: A map pairs names with values, like labels on paint pots. Your task: Change the lookup from sun to sea.
learningObjectives: Change the lookup from sun to sea.
Explain the example for use a colour map

blocks.text: A map pairs names with values, like labels on paint pots. map.get looks up the value for one label.
Use Dart Sass on your computer. Install Node.js first, with help if needed. Save SCSS examples as lesson.scss and run npx sass lesson.scss lesson.css. This site does not compile Sass.
Read the code step by step

items: `@use` loads a Sass module once. A module prefix keeps its variables and functions distinct from local names.
`map.get` looks up the value belonging to a key in a Sass map. A missing key returns null.

blocks.text: The note background is gold. The key sun selects that entry from the map.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use a key that exists. A missing key gives null, so the expected style may be left out.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the lookup from sun to sea.
